ticket: Managers must be denied Admin users when opening its URL directly.

criteria.text: Managers receive Permission denied when visiting /crm/admin/users directly.

scenarios: Sign in as manager. Navigate directly to /crm/admin/users. Assert the Permission denied heading is visible.

ticket: Viewers can inspect Accounts but cannot edit them.
developerScope: Implement read-only Accounts controls for viewers.

criteria.text: Viewer sees Accounts and the Edit account button is disabled.

scenarios: Sign in as viewer. Open Accounts. Assert Accounts heading is visible and Edit account button is disabled.

ticket: Sales users must provide name, email and source before saving a lead.
developerScope: Add required-field validation for sales lead creation.

criteria.text: Submitting a lead with all required fields blank shows the required-fields alert.

scenarios: Sign in as sales. Open Leads. Leave name, email and source blank. Submit. Assert the alert says Lead name, email, and source are required.

ticket: Managers are not allowed to access Admin users.
